findings.text: f-tccfor-006 declares §6 "independent of §2 to §4" while §6's declared write paths (`skills/reckon-build/SKILL.md`, `.../references/sprint-orchestration.md`, `.../references/coordinator-reference.md`) are exactly the files §3 rewrites to a 4,000/12,000-word ceiling; no depends-on, gate or ordering sentence relates §6 to §3, whereas §5 — which had the same overlap — carries "This section runs before §3". findings.text: the new followup f-tccfor-006 schedules §6 as a followup, which is the pattern this plan already retired: f-tccfor-001's own outcome at `plan.html:104` records "Moved into §4 as an implementable section, because the roadmap schedules sections and never followups", and `skills/reckon-build/SKILL.md:438-440` states the same rule ("becomes a plan section … and never a followup"). §6 already has an `implementable` declaration at `plan.html:24`, so the followup is a second scheduling authority that goes stale the moment §6 lands.

findings.text: §6's deliverable rewrites the mirrored sentence in three skill files, but the done-when measures only the composed prompt, and the only test that reaches the skill mirrors (`test_skill_contract_parity.py`) covers `LIMIT_SKILL_FILES` = `SKILL.md` and `references/sprint-orchestration.md` only (`tests/test_skill_contract_parity.py:128-131`). `references/coordinator-reference.md:805` is therefore in the deliverable and in no measure, so §6 can close green with that file still carrying the unqualified sentence.

findings.reason: one clause naming a brief prompt that may land turns an assertion that fails on the first non-landing brief the node happens to compose into a measure the node can satisfy and a reader can re-run.
findings.text: the done-when requires the closure block on "a composed brief prompt", but the composer emits `closure_authority_contract` only when `can_land` is true (`reckon/crew/prompts.py:756`, `:775`), so a brief node whose fence withholds repository paths receives an empty block and no such assertion can hold for it; the measure does not say which brief composition it means.
